text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ended up participating as staff for the academy's
"Kids' Running Workshop."
The instructors for today are—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Spe-san, we're counting on you today!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We would deeply appreciate your advice
so we can guide the children properly!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(W-Wait, I'm the oldest one here...?! Alright!
I have to show them how a good senpai acts...!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
L-Leave it to me, both of you...! 
Please, rely on me as much as you like...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
E-Everyone...! First, we're going to do something
called interval training...! 
We'll alternate between running slow and running fast!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Umm, so as for who gives the pace signals—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Spe-san, leave that to Dia-chan and me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Alright, we're picking up the speed~~!!
Dash, dash~~!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Daaash...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Okay, 3, 2, 1, slow it down from here~~!
Slow, slow, slow, slow~~!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Slooow...ー!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Is this slow enough...? 
Hmm? ...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(Those two are amazing! They're leading everyone
so well...! Alright, I have to...!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'll give the next signal!!
I'll run along with you, so follow me!
Ready, set—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hauhh...?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ow-ow-ow... S-Sorry, I guess I got
a little too carried away...

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! You're such a klutz~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah! H-Hey, no laughing at me~~!!

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Spe-chan got mad!
Run awaaay~~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wait up~! 
I'm gonna catch you~~!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, she's coming this way~~!
Don't let her catch you, guys~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it turned into an impromptu game of tag, it was
serving as interval training in its own right—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, everyone looks like they're having so much fun!
Spe-san really is amazing after all...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, they're so much more relaxed than before!
Let's try the tag method too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week's playful training continued after that.
It turned into a lively workshop filled with children's
smiles until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Spe-san, we learned so much today!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Please let us join you again sometime!
Well then, we shall take our leave!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Both of them are so dependable, desu ne.
They ended up helping me out so much...
choice_data_list: You did a fantastic job too!
You did a fantastic job too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eh, no, I was just causing trouble the whole time...!
Because of me, things went totally off schedule and all...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it, today made me realize
all over again just how unreliable I am.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...But I can't stay like this forever...! 
I have to keep giving it my all so everyone can count on me, yup...!
